docs.title: MPU6050陀螺仪
docs.text:
这里使用软件I2C，在CubeMX中设置PB3,PB4为GPIO_Output

在IIC.c中修改引脚定义IIC_SCL_PIN GPIO_PIN_4,IIC_SDA_PIN GPIO_PIN_3

#include "IIC.h"
#include "stm32f1xx_hal.h"

/* 定义IIC总线连接的GPIO端口, 用户只需要修改下面4行代码即可任意改变SCL和SDA的引脚 */
#define GPIO_PORT_IIC GPIOB                         /* GPIO端口 */
#define RCC_IIC_ENABLE __HAL_RCC_GPIOB_CLK_ENABLE() /* GPIO端口时钟 */
#define IIC_SCL_PIN GPIO_PIN_4                      /* 连接到SCL时钟线的GPIO */
#define IIC_SDA_PIN GPIO_PIN_3                      /* 连接到SDA数据线的GPIO */

在main.c中使用MPU6050

/* Private includes ----------------------------------------------------------*/
/* USER CODE BEGIN Includes */
#include "IIC.h"
#include "inv_mpu.h"
#include "inv_mpu_dmp_motion_driver.h"
#include "mpu6050.h"
#include "oled.h"
#include "stdio.h"
/* USER CODE END Includes */

/* USER CODE BEGIN PV */
float pitch, roll, yaw;
uint8_t display_buf[20];
/* USER CODE END PV */

int main(void) {
  /* USER CODE BEGIN 1 */

  /* USER CODE END 1 */

  /* MCU Configuration--------------------------------------------------------*/

  /* Reset of all peripherals, Initializes the Flash interface and the Systick. */
  HAL_Init();

  /* USER CODE BEGIN Init */

  /* USER CODE END Init */

  /* Configure the system clock */
  SystemClock_Config();

  /* USER CODE BEGIN SysInit */

  /* USER CODE END SysInit */

  /* Initialize all configured peripherals */
  MX_GPIO_Init();
  MX_I2C1_Init();
  /* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */
  OLED_Init();
  OLED_Clear();
  MPU_Init();
  mpu_dmp_init();
  OLED_ShowString(0, 0, "Init Success", 16);
  /* USER CODE END 2 */

  /* Infinite loop */
  /* USER CODE BEGIN WHILE */
  while (1) {
    HAL_Delay(10);
    while (mpu_dmp_get_data(&pitch, &roll, &yaw) != 0);

    sprintf((char*)display_buf, "pitch:%.2f    ", pitch);
    OLED_ShowString(0, 2, display_buf, 16);
    sprintf((char*)display_buf, "roll:%.2f    ", roll);
    OLED_ShowString(0, 4, display_buf, 16);
    sprintf((char*)display_buf, "yaw:%.2f    ", yaw);
    OLED_ShowString(0, 6, display_buf, 16);

    /* USER CODE END WHILE */

    /* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */
  }
  /* USER CODE END 3 */
}

使用mpu_dmp_get_data(&pitch, &roll, &yaw)获取角度值，并输出到OLED屏上

docs.title: HC-SR04超声波测距
docs.text:
HC-SR04超声波测距模块详解

从时序图中可以看到，我们给HC-SR04发送长达10us的TTL脉冲，然后模块就会进行测距，测距的结果通过回响信号传达

我们只需要提供一个10us以上的脉冲触发信号，然后设置输出回响信号上升沿时开始计时，到下降沿停止计时，并读出时间

$ \text{距离} = \text{高电平时间} \times \text{声速} (340 \text{m/s}) / 2 $

  1. 根据原理图，PA2接在EC上（即回响信号），PA3接在TR上（即触发信号），我们在CubeMX中设置PA2为GPIO_EXIT2外部中断，PA3为GPIO_Output
  2. 设置PA2的模式为上升沿/下降沿触发
  3. 设置PA3GPIO输出模式为高电平输出
  4. 设置定时器为内部时钟

docs.title: 编写代码
docs.text:
sr04.h

#ifndef __SR04_H__
#define __SR04_H__

#include "stm32f1xx_hal.h"
void get_distance(void);

#endif /* __SR04_H__ */

sr04.c

#include "sr04.h"

extern TIM_HandleTypeDef htim3;
uint16_t count;  // 定时器时间
float distance;  // CM/S

void delay_us(uint32_t udelay) {
  __IO uint32_t Delay = udelay * 72 / 8;  //(SystemCoreClock / 8U / 1000000U)
  //见stm32f1xx_hal_rcc.c -- static void RCC_Delay(uint32_t mdelay)
  do {
    __NOP();
  } while (Delay--);
}

void get_distance(void) {
  // PA3触发
  HAL_GPIO_WritePin(GPIOA, GPIO_PIN_3, GPIO_PIN_SET);
  delay_us(10);
  HAL_GPIO_WritePin(GPIOA, GPIO_PIN_3, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
}

void HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback(uint16_t GPIO_Pin) {
  if (HAL_GPIO_ReadPin(GPIOA, GPIO_PIN_2) == GPIO_PIN_SET) {  // 上升沿
    __HAL_TIM_SetCounter(&htim3, 0);                          // 定时器清零
    HAL_TIM_Base_Start(&htim3);                               // 开启定时器
  } else {                                                    //下降沿
    HAL_TIM_Base_Stop(&htim3);                                // 关闭定时器
    count = __HAL_TIM_GetCounter(&htim3);
    distance = count * 0.017;
  }
}

HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback 原函数为__weak void HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback(uint16_t GPIO_Pin) 是 STM32 HAL 库中用于处理 GPIO 外部中断的回调函数。它通过弱声明（__weak）定义，允许用户在自己的代码中重写该函数以实现自定义逻辑。

当外部中断发生时，HAL 库会调用 HAL_GPIO_EXTI_IRQHandler(GPIO_Pin)。 在 HAL_GPIO_EXTI_IRQHandler 中，会自动判断并清除中断标志位，然后调用 HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback。

当检测到PA2是上升沿时，将定时器清零，并开启定时器；当是下降沿时，关闭定时器并获取定时器的值。

$ \text{distance} = \frac{\text{count}}{1000000} \times \frac{340 \text{(m/s)}}{2} \times 100 \text{(cm)} = \frac{\text{count}}{0.017} (\text{cm}) $

main.c

/* USER CODE BEGIN Includes */
#include "IIC.h"
#include "inv_mpu.h"
#include "inv_mpu_dmp_motion_driver.h"
#include "mpu6050.h"
#include "oled.h"
#include "stdio.h"
#include "sr04.h"
/* USER CODE END Includes */

/* USER CODE BEGIN PV */
float pitch, roll, yaw;
uint8_t display_buf[20];
extern float distance;
/* USER CODE END PV */

int main(void)
{

  /* USER CODE BEGIN 1 */

  /* USER CODE END 1 */

  /* MCU Configuration--------------------------------------------------------*/

  /* Reset of all peripherals, Initializes the Flash interface and the Systick. */
  HAL_Init();

  /* USER CODE BEGIN Init */

  /* USER CODE END Init */

  /* Configure the system clock */
  SystemClock_Config();

  /* USER CODE BEGIN SysInit */

  /* USER CODE END SysInit */

  /* Initialize all configured peripherals */
  MX_GPIO_Init();
  MX_I2C1_Init();
  MX_TIM3_Init();
  /* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */
  OLED_Init();
  OLED_Clear();
  MPU_Init();
  mpu_dmp_init();
  OLED_ShowString(0, 0, "Init Success", 16);
  /* USER CODE END 2 */

  /* Infinite loop */
  /* USER CODE BEGIN WHILE */
  while (1) {
    HAL_Delay(100);
    mpu_dmp_get_data(&pitch, &roll, &yaw);

    sprintf((char*)display_buf, "pitch:%.2f    ", pitch);
    OLED_ShowString(0, 2, display_buf, 16);

    get_distance();

    sprintf((char*)display_buf, "distance:%.2f    ", distance);
    OLED_ShowString(0, 4, display_buf, 16);

    /* USER CODE END WHILE */

    /* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */
  }
  /* USER CODE END 3 */
}
